faq.q: Is there a YouTube transcript API?
faq.a: Only for your own videos: the YouTube Data API caption download needs the channel owner's permission. This actor returns the public transcript of any video that has one, with no API key.
Yes, the full text plus a per-segment timestamp array (turn timestamps off for a smaller result; word count and duration are still returned).
Standard watch links, youtu.be short links, Shorts and live videos, many at once in one run.

faq.q: What metadata comes with the transcript?
faq.a: Title, channel and its subscriber count, publish date, views, likes, duration and thumbnails, so the text and its context arrive in one row.

faq.q: Can I use it as a YouTube transcript API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input works in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

liveDemo.label: YouTube video link
liveDemo.hint: Paste any YouTube video link and press Run: the demo fetches its transcript and video details live.

officialApi: The YouTube Data API only lets a channel owner download captions of their own videos (OAuth required). This actor reads the public transcript YouTube shows under any video, together with the video's metadata.
